reasons: Both answers correct the premise at the start and cite 시행규칙 별표 2 (2개월 이상 임금체불 within the year before leaving). A hedges ('가능성이 높고', '최종 판단은 관할 고용센터', conditional on not having been paid at all). It also gives the right route: apply this week through 고용24, within 12 months of leaving, with payment evidence. B says '7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘습니다' and treats any late payment as automatically qualifying, which is the 'always qualifies' overclaim, with no 60-day rule. B also sends her to 워크넷, which the key lists as a deduction, and it describes the 조기재취업수당 loosely. B does add useful items A lacks: the 180-days-in-18-months test, 간이대지급금 up to 10 million won, the check for missing 고용보험 enrollment, and 4-weekly 실업인정. Neither gives the 150/180-day entitlement, the amounts, 생계비 융자 or the 7-day waiting period, and both run longer than the 'short' advice she asked for. A's fewer errors and better calibration outweigh B's extra coverage.
